{{Top|leg}}
'''Electromagnetic radiation''' was a form of [[Radiation/Legends|radiation]]. This type of radiation could be absorbed and dissipated by [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force users]] using [[Tutaminis]].<ref name="RPG">[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game (first edition)|''Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game'']]</ref>

The [[Gotal/Legends|Gotal]] were particularly sensitive to electromagnetic radiation. As a result, [[Vreshann Electronics, Incorporated]] manufactured a handheld [[EMS Scanner]].

A kind of radiation including visible light, radio waves, gamma rays, and X-rays, in which electric and magnetic fields vary simultaneously. [[Hassat-durr]] users could draw this into their bodies and manipulate it to a certain extent before it became dangerous.
